title: Intelligence Brief
subtitle: LG monitors have silently installed an ad-serving , HN's #9 story claims GPT-5.6 used a prompt to clos, Kimi K3 ranks #1 on SpreadsheetBench 2 over Claude

insights.text: LG monitors have silently installed an ad-serving application via Windows Update since at least 2024, with zero consent prompt, the moment a monitor is plugged in. Gamers Nexus tested 32 consecutive boots and saw a McAfee 30-day-trial promotion during 31 of them; the app requests access to all system resources and registers as a startup program.

HN's #9 story claims GPT-5.6 used a prompt to close a 30-year gap in convex optimization (an Omega(d^2) lower bound matching a decades-old algorithm). A nine-page discovery search found no linked preprint, named author, or venue — the same unverified pattern as the separately-circulating claim that GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra proved the Cycle Double Cover Conjecture, which itself carries the caveat that no one has confirmed it's correct.

Kimi K3 ranks #1 on SpreadsheetBench 2 over Claude Fable 5 by a 34.8-to-34.7 margin -- a 0.1-point win the r/LocalLLaMA headline ('surpassing Claude Fable 5') doesn't mention, extending yesterday's finding that K3 wins specific narrow benchmarks while trailing Fable 5/GPT-5.6 Sol on Moonshot's own aggregate table.

OpenAI's Codex usage-limit reset saga (three full resets between June 25-29 after a faulty anti-abuse system spiked consumption 10-20x) is still generating OpenAI Developer Community complaints in mid-July, including banked resets disappearing in the new ChatGPT desktop app.

Bubbles (bubbles.town) monitors 4,800+ independent personal blogs via RSS, auto-publishing new posts to a community-voted feed with Fediverse comments and full RSS/OPML republishing -- an aggregator built to surface the open web rather than wall it off.

OpenMarkdown is a local-first markdown editor (Tauri 2, no telemetry, files never leave disk) where a CLI/plugin/MCP-connected agent can co-edit the same file a human has open via inline @agent commands -- ranked #5 on Product Hunt's July 18 leaderboard.

'Hardcore IndieWeb: Run your own website 100% independently for only $0.01/day' (HN #14, 113 points) makes the case for fully self-hosted personal sites as a deliberate reaction to platform dependency -- a third same-day signal alongside Bubbles and OpenMarkdown.

tirth8205/code-review-graph accelerated from +74/day (19,839 total) yesterday to +355/day (20,281 total) today -- a local-first code-intelligence graph for MCP and CLI whose growth is not cooling on a normal post-launch curve.
